typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BEGIN_DT as timestamp (),
	EmailMessage as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	END_DT as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileName_Prefix as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	MarketName as string (),
	OutputPath as string (),
	Rept_Begin_Day as integer (),
	RowCount_Eligibility as integer (),
	Run_Type as string (),
	SendToMindoulaOutbound as string ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Declare @GRGR_CK varchar(10) = ?   SELECT ResultSet = CAST(CONCAT(UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,\'|\',INSURANCE_EFFECTIVE_DATE,\'|\',INSURANCE_TERMINATION_DATE) AS VARCHAR(MAX))		  FROM EXTRACT.MINDOULA_STAGE_MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY WHERE (GRGR_CK = @GRGR_CK OR ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\')		 GROUP BY UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER, INSURANCE_EFFECTIVE_DATE, INSURANCE_TERMINATION_DATE, ROW_INDICATOR          ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetEligibilityData
GetEligibilityData sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> EligibilityFileOutbound
